purpose: Pre-candidate source selection and visual grounding annotations for actual textbook pages
rendering: pdftoppm -f PHYSICAL -l PHYSICAL -scale-to 1200 -singlefile -png SOURCE OUTPUT; resulting 928x1200 full page. Coordinates top-left origin; x2/y2 are right/bottom bounds.
copyright_scope: Downloaded from author official pages for authorized private local testing. No redistribution permission inferred. Entire books and page crops remain /tmp, not repo/docs.
annotation_limitations: Single independent annotating Codex agent using visual inspection, not human expert/dual-annotator consensus. Association descriptions are task references, not measured candidate results.
